@graph.name: chemotion_example
@graph.description: Reductive catalytic fractionation (RCF) of spruce wood (Picea abies): wood, a 5 wt% Pd/C catalyst and methanol in a stainless steel autoclave under 50 bar hydrogen at 151 °C for 3 h; the lignin goes into the methanol as a phenolic oil (mainly 4-propylguaiacol), the cellulose stays behind as a solid pulp. Two runs on two batches of wood - the reactions LCJ-R5 and LCJ-R8 of Congjian Lin's Chemotion collection 'Experiment', given as an example of a Chemotion export.
